Write a commit message for the following changes using Conventional Commits format.

Rules:
- Type must be one of: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore
- Add scope when relevant (e.g., `feat(instrumentation)`, `fix(build)`)
- Subject line: imperative mood, max 50 chars, no period
- Body: explain WHAT and WHY, not HOW
- Sign-off: include `Signed-off-by: DevComputaria <dev@devcomputaria.com.br>`
- Use Portuguese or English (consistent with repo language)
